Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of Type II Diabetes Mellitus (without chronic kidney disease); AND
○ Trial and failure (e.g., A1c goal not met) of, intolerance, or contraindication to metformin; OR
• Diagnosis of Type II Diabetes Mellitus (with chronic kidney disease (ICD-10 Group N18)); AND
○ Trial and failure of, intolerance, or contraindication to ≥ 1 SGLT2 inhibitor plus metformin. AND
• Not used in combination with a GLP-1 receptor (such as Ozempic or Mounjaro) UNLESS the member is changing therapy and the GLP medication will be discontinued.
